# Debian 13 (trixie) arm64 packages that Gale is compiled against and that the
# AppImage bundles. scripts/vendor-debs.sh resolves their full dependency
# closure (Depends + Pre-Depends, no Recommends) and stores every .deb in
# debs/. Edit this list, then run the "Vendor Debian libraries" workflow.

# Runtime stack bundled into the AppImage (SteamOS does not ship it).
libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0
libjavascriptcoregtk-4.1-0
libgtk-3-0
# GnuTLS GIO module: HTTPS inside WebKit's network process.
glib-networking
# SVG loader for gdk-pixbuf.
librsvg2-common

# Build-only: headers, pkg-config files and link-time libraries.
libc6-dev
libgtk-3-dev
libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev
libjavascriptcoregtk-4.1-dev
libsoup-3.0-dev
libayatana-appindicator3-dev
libdbus-1-dev
